application_type_full: Approval of details reserved by a condition (discharge)
description: Details of Conditions 6 (Water Usage), 8 (Cycle Parking), 12 (Contamination) submitted pursuant planning permission 00707/11/P2 dated 26/11/2018 for the erection of rear extensions at basement, ground, and first floor levels with balconies and conversion from one upper floor flat to two flats with cycle storage.
decision_conditions: Reason : 1 - The application fails to satisfy the requirements of Condition 6 as it does not demonstrate that the development has achieved an internal water use of 105L/person/day or less. It would fail to demonstrate the protection and conservation of water supplies and resources in accordance with London Plan Policy SI 5 and Local Plan Policy EQ2.

Reason : 2 - The details submitted fail to satisfy the requirement of Condition 8 as insufficient information has been provided to demonstrate compliance with the cycle parking provision as detailed at application stage in accordance with Local Plan Policy EC2.

Reason : 3 - No details have been submitted for Condition 12 and the application therefore fails to demonstrate that the development can be implemented and occupied with adequate regard for public and environmental safety in accordance with Local Plan Policy EQ8.
